sections.title: Review queue
sections.sql: select code,name,owner,status,issues,current_review,review_due from v_review_queue order by review_due

sections.title: Attention
sections.sql: select code,rule,issue from v_issues order by code,rule

sections.title: Field decisions
sections.sql: select code,field,source_values,chosen_value from v_field_conflicts order by code,field

sections.title: Source lineage
sections.sql: select code,source_system,source_key,version,current_version,stale_link from v_crosswalk order by code,source_system

sections.title: Ready for owner-authorised reuse
sections.sql: select code,name,business_id,country,address,review_due from v_ready order by code
